faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Banda District Assistant Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Banda District Assistant Accountant recruitment is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Accountant post in the Banda District recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Accountant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Accountant position is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess knowledge of computer typing and file making. Preference will be given to retired Civil Court employees.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Accountant role?
faq.answer: The salary will be based on the last drawn pay minus the net pension (before commutation).

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Accountant post?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Assistant Accountant post will be done by a Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Which district is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Banda District administration.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Assistant Accountant position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Assistant Accountant position is contractual.
